platform_note: Facebook Pages can be posted by API. Profiles, groups, LinkedIn and X get a ready-made pack to post by hand.
kpi_approved_hint: Checked by you, image by image
kpi_published_hint: By API or recorded by hand
kpi_links_ok: Every post carries a tracked link
kpi_links_missing: Set links in campaign.yaml before publishing
matrix_help: Each language is its own complete post. Click a post to preview it.
workflow_1: Analyse: let AI describe the audience and pains in each language.
workflow_2: Write: AI drafts each post per language — never a sentence-by-sentence translation.
workflow_3: Preview & approve: render the images, read everything, approve exactly that version.
workflow_4: Publish: to your Facebook Page, or download a pack and record where you posted it.
workflow_5: Learn: collect comments and numbers, then let AI propose what to build next.
ai_mode_paste_help: No API key needed: copy the prompt into claude.ai and paste the answer back. The same checks apply.
no_api_key: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env — use copy-paste mode.
use_readme: Also send the tool's README to the AI
readme_paste: Paste the README (or choose a file above)
analyse_help: AI writes the positioning for each language on its own: who feels the pain, in their own words, and what to promise honestly.
write_help: Pick a post and the languages. Each language is written separately for its own audience, checked, and saved as a draft.
custom_slot_help: Describe this post in your notes below.
preview_help: Edit, render the images, read them as your audience will, then approve this exact version.
edit_yaml_help: One file per language. **text** highlights, ~~text~~ strikes through.
rendering: Rendering in a headless browser… (about a second per image)
render_failed: The images for this post could not be rendered. Fix the errors in the list under the YAML box and render again; any images shown are from the previous render.
approve_explain: The approval is tied to this exact content. Any later edit cancels it automatically.
approve_confirm: I have read every image and caption in {lang}.
approve_first: approve the post on the Preview page first.
publish_help: One post, one language, one platform at a time. Every action is recorded in the history.
platform_api_help: Your Facebook Page by API — or a pack for your profile and groups.
manual_only: No API here: download the pack, post by hand, then record it below.
fb_not_configured: Set FB_PAGE_ID and FB_PAGE_TOKEN in .env to post to your Page.
smoke_needed: Check the connection once before the first post.
publish_confirm_explain: This posts publicly to “{page}”. Type the Page name to confirm.
resolve_failed: It is not on the Page
mark_posted_title: Record a post you made by hand
mark_posted_more: Posted it by hand too (profile, group…)? Record it
mark_posted_help: So the history and the demand analysis include it.
history_help: Every post you published: which tool, which language, where and when — with the reactions and comments collected so far.
history_empty: Nothing published yet. Publish a post or record one you posted by hand.
add_comments_help: Copy the comments from the post and paste them here, one per paragraph (blank line between). Names are not needed — leave them out.
insights_help: Numbers decide whether there is demand; comments say what people need. AI reads both and proposes what to do next.
no_numbers: No numbers yet: add them from Facebook Insights after each post.
verdict_help: Judged only once the minimum counts in campaign.yaml are reached.
add_numbers_help: Copy them from Facebook Insights (or the platform's statistics) a few days after posting.
ai_analysis_help: Reads the history, the numbers above and every comment collected, then reports demand and a prioritised plan.
survey_summary_hint: Paste the output of: python studio.py survey responses.csv
no_posts: No posts in the selected languages yet.
guide_help: The workflow, connecting a Facebook Page, AI options and the safety rails.
guide_flow_1: Fill in tools/<tool>/brief.yaml with facts only — every post may only claim what is there.
guide_flow_2: Analyse, then write each post in each language (or edit the YAML yourself).
guide_flow_3: Render, read every image, set the post to ready and approve it.
guide_flow_4: Publish one post at a time; post by hand where there is no API and record it.
guide_flow_5: A few days later: scan or paste comments, add the numbers from Insights.
guide_flow_6: Run the demand analysis and decide: build, change the pitch, or stop.
guide_fb_1: Facebook allows API posts only to Pages — not to personal profiles or groups.
guide_fb_2: Create an app at developers.facebook.com, get a Page access token with pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement.
guide_fb_3: Put FB_PAGE_ID and FB_PAGE_TOKEN in .env (never in YAML), restart the app, then click Check connection.
guide_fb_4: Make your first post to a test Page. Details: docs/facebook-page.md.
guide_ai_1: With ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env the app calls Claude directly; the model is set in studio.yaml.
guide_ai_2: Without a key, copy-paste mode gives you the prompt for claude.ai and checks the answer.
guide_ai_3: AI output is always a draft: it is checked (no links, no files, no invented numbers) and you approve it.
guide_safe_1: The app only listens on this computer and refuses requests from other websites.
guide_safe_2: Nothing is posted without your approval of that exact version and the Page name typed.
guide_safe_3: A post that may have gone out is never sent twice: you confirm on the Page first.
guide_safe_4: Comments are stored without names and are not committed to git.
